text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 400, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "sales from red hats were $400"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 2, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "hats of two different colors"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 0.5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "half the total amount she earned from selling green hats"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 2, "unit": "months", "kind": "count", "span": "the total amount she made in two months"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "3/4 of the total sales of the first month (numerator)"}, {"id": "q6", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "3/4 of the total sales of the first month (denominator)"}], "plan": [{"op": "div", "args": ["q1", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "red hat sales divided by one-half = green hat sales"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "red hat sales plus green hat sales = first month's total"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q5", "q6"], "out": "s3", "note": "the fraction 3/4 as a value"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "s3"], "out": "s4", "note": "first month's total times 3/4 = second month's sales"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s2", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "first month's total plus second month's total"}], "target": {"kind": "money", "scope": "the total amount she made across the two months"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 2, "reason": "'two different colors' just names that there are two hat colors, not a numeric operand needed for the sales total"}, {"value": 2, "reason": "'two months' just names the period being totaled; the two months' amounts are added individually rather than using this count as a multiplier"}]}
